description: A combo box that displays a multi-column grid in its dropdown for rich item selection.

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: Data source for the dropdown grid.

parameters.name: AccentInsensitiveFilter
parameters.description: When true (default), filtering ignores diacritics via FormD normalization — e.g. "usti" matches "Ústí" and "práha" matches "Praha". Set to false for accent-sensitive (but still case-insensitive) filtering.

parameters.name: Filterable
parameters.description: Whether the user can filter the dropdown list. Default is true.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder shown when no value is selected.

parameters.name: ShowClearButton
parameters.description: Whether to show a clear button. Default is true.

parameters.name: TextField
parameters.description: Expression that returns the display text for the trigger when an item is selected.

parameters.name: ValueField
parameters.description: Expression that returns the value for a given item. Required for selection matching.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Column definitions for the dropdown grid.

parameters.name: MultiSelect
parameters.description: Enables multi-select mode: selections are tracked via SelectedValues and rendered as chips in the trigger. Default false.

parameters.name: SelectedValues
parameters.description: The selected values in multi-select mode (source of truth when MultiSelect is true).

parameters.name: SelectedValuesChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the multi-select selection changes.

parameters.name: AllowCreateNew
parameters.description: Shows an inline "create new" row that calls DataProvider.CreateAsync. Requires DataProvider. Default false.

parameters.name: ShowRecent
parameters.description: Shows a "recent" group loaded from DataProvider.GetRecentAsync when the dropdown opens. Requires DataProvider. Default false.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Optional data provider that powers the create-new and recent-items features (opt-in). The grid still binds to Data.
